t1.text: Oia: product images for a cosmetics reseller (Mây Cosmetics, 140 products)

s1.text:
How it works (16-11-2026)

1. Product = name + photos + facts. Facts are read from the supplier sheet or description, checked by the seller, and keep their source for small print.
2. Pick concepts (main, benefit, numbers, ingredients, how to use, why buy here). Oia suggests text from facts; the seller edits freely. No claim checking (owner decision).
3. One shop template on every image. Supplier photos are rebuilt in it, so shops buying from the same source still look different.
4. Only the Main background uses AI; the other images are 0 AI layouts.
5. Bulk: concepts with missing facts are skipped, not invented. AI limit pauses and resumes; nothing is charged twice.
6. Offers are a separate image or frame with an end date, removed when the sale ends. No prices on images.
7. Export editable (PPTX/SVG) for Canva for last-mile edits.

Product drawings are placeholders; a real run with real photos is still owed.
